text:
toni-docs: Drafting the changelog entry for the new routing metrics dashboard. Short draft and the JS/Python SDK snippet below — need quick read for accuracy before I open the PR.

frank-eng: looks good, pls include runtime min version (v1.6.2) and a sentence about metrics latency (90th p95 ~120ms).

maya-sdk: SDK snippets — show both REST and JS. Note JS uses camelCase option `includeRouting` while REST uses `include_routing`.

toni-docs: JS snippet:
```js
await client.metrics.getRouteMetrics({ routeId: 'my-route', includeRouting: true });
```

REST example:
```http
GET /v1/metrics/route/my-route?include_routing=true
Authorization: Bearer <key>
```

oliver-pm: product note: add a short "what this helps" blurb: helps ops troubleshoot route-level cost spikes and fallback events. Also request we add a small known-issue: dashboards may show delayed data for routes with low traffic for up to 30 mins.

frank-eng: confirm we added the migrations for dashboards link — the anchor changed in the site refactor. Ticket #8401.

toni-docs: noted, adding redirect and Support template. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7610 (snippets, changelog, redirects).

deploy-bot: toni-docs pushed branch toni/route-metrics-changelog -> staging/docs (CI: passing) :white_check_mark:

toni-docs: thanks all, will merge after one more reviewer and schedule publish for Tue 07:30 PT. Closing thread; will update with the publish URL.
